text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap continues to run in races. As 
her fanbase gradually grows, a certain 
proposal comes her way...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: —I see, an interview, huh?

Oguri Cap's recent success seems to have 
become a hot topic among reporters. She 
received numerous interview requests as a 
promising Umamusume.

This is a great chance to boost Oguri 
Cap's popularity. We should definitely 
accept this.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It feels like it's been a while. Back in 
my homeland, I'd get these after every 
single race.
choice_data_list: So, are you pretty good at it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not good at it at all. I'm not a 
skilled speaker, after all.
choice_data_list: It's okay to say no, you know.

text_block_list.text:
If you struggle with it, there's no need 
to push yourself. That was my thinking 
when I suggested it, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...No, I want to take it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"If I can just speak well here, maybe 
everyone will acknowledge me."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I think... now is the time to push myself. 
Yes, please let me take the test.

I was concerned about how burdened she 
seemed, but respecting Oguri Cap's wishes, 
I decided to accept every single interview 
request...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—Now then, a quick word on your 
enthusiasm heading into the race!”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ......Um. I'll do my best to run... well!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"...With that, today's interview is 
concluded. Thank you very much."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No problem. I've just been talking more 
than usual, so I'm a little tired. Please 
call in the next person.

Due to scheduling constraints, Oguri Cap 
has been doing interviews back-to-back. 
Though she shows signs of fatigue, 
everything is going smoothly so far.

"Though she's putting a bit too much 
pressure on herself, at this rate it 
should all end without issue. Or so I 
thought..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...Are you Oguri Cap? I'm with the Nessho 
Shimbun.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, I see. So you want to do your best 
for everyone back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That's right... I mean, yes. I want to 
show everyone back home... how hard I'm 
working."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
...So, what's your ultimate goal? What 
kind of races do you want to run in?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh... That's... ...

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, okay. Understood. Yeah, this is 
fine now."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh...? A-Are you done already?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I pretty much got the gist of it. 
...Just not really feeling all that hyped, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Let me give you one piece of advice: the 
Tracen Center isn't so soft that hard work 
alone will bring you victory.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine. It's not that I'm feeling 
down. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, I saw that, ya know~? What're 
you getting beat for, Oguri?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Tama?

The one who appeared was Oguri Cap's 
roommate, Tamamo Cross. I've heard she's a 
dear friend who looks out for her.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That reporter earlier sure was a real 
sourpuss. Giving me 'advice' like 
that—talk about none of their business!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I must have appeared unreliable in that 
reporter's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~! You really are totally out of it! 
You just gonna let 'em talk to ya like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Ya hate bein' looked down on all the 
time, don'tcha!? Pisses ya off, right? Ya 
wanna prove 'em wrong, don'tcha!?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aah, what the heck, why'd you do that?! 
You ain't gonna get anything by playin' 
the good girl!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Expose my true nature, win, win, and keep 
winning my way to the top! That's the only 
way to make every last one of them 
understand!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"That's how I clawed my way up this far 
too, after all!"

Tamamo Cross made her debut before Oguri 
Cap did. She must have gone through a lot 
of struggles along the way.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look, you're not good with words, 
so trying to talk fancy is just gonna 
backfire on ya!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If ye get it, then shut yer trap and go 
train! See ya!

After Tamamo Cross left like a 
whirlwind...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama was right. Somewhere deep down, I was 
trying too hard to say the right thing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, my feelings won't get across like 
that. That reporter was probably 
exasperated for the same reason.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, I've got a favor to ask. Will 
you hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you. In that case—

Oguri Cap's request was to invite every 
single reporter who had asked for an 
interview into the press conference room.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for gathering here, everyone. 
There's just one thing I want to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Please... watch me run. I want you to 
witness my strength... with your own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I will certainly live up to your 
expectations. Because I am strong.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
More than anyone else in the Twinkle 
Series... I am the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...That is all. Thank you for your time.

The atmosphere had clearly changed from 
before the press conference began to now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
This is a declaration of war, isn't it? 
Oguri Cap is no ordinary foe...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I need to get back quickly and publish 
this article! It's definitely going to 
make waves!

Oguri Cap's sincere dedication has truly 
moved the hearts of the people.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"...Guess I'm rewriting that article. 
Sheesh, the headline writes itself now."

The next day, bold headlines reading "I Am 
Strong" filled the newspapers.

"The spotlight, which had remained 
somewhat vague despite her wins, suddenly 
converged on her all at once."

With all this attention, Oguri Cap is sure 
to claim a grand victory. —I can't wait 
for the next race!
